column3: a cursed gothic castle on a stormy cliff in Silverpine Forest: worgen silhouettes, howling wolves, iron chandeliers, cobwebs, crooked gravestones, cold moonlight through stained glass
a grim stone prison beneath Stormwind: iron bars, chains, torches, damp brick walls, rats, overturned barrels, Defias red bandanas
a gold mine tunnel under Westfall leading to a hidden cove: mine carts on rails, wooden support beams, goblin machinery, a pirate ship's prow in the dark water, Defias red bandanas
a maze of giant thorny brambles in the Barrens: huge twisting thorn vines, quilboar tusks and bones, totem poles, dry red earth, a few spiky boar silhouettes
a flooded ancient night elf temple on the Ashenvale coast: half-sunken marble columns, dark water, kelp, naga silhouettes, a moonwell glow, a giant hydra shadow
an ancient titan vault in the Badlands: massive carved stone guardians, titan glyphs, dwarven dig scaffolding, stone keepers, dusty golden torchlight
an irradiated gnome city of gears: pipes, cogs, broken mechanical spiders, green toxic glow, rivets, steam, leper gnome silhouettes
the sunken Temple of Atal'Hakkar in the Swamp of Sorrows: overgrown troll ziggurat stairs, green dragon shadows, serpent carvings, murky swamp water, blood-red glow of Hakkar
a quilboar burrow taken over by the undead Scourge: thorny brambles, bones, skulls, necromantic purple-green glow, a lich shadow, tattered banners
a fanatical crusader monastery in Tirisfal Glades: crimson banners with the Scarlet sun, cathedral arches, candles, stacked books, a graveyard with crooked crosses
a desert troll city in Tanaris: sandstone pyramids and stairs, troll idols and tiki masks, scarab beetles, sun-bleached bones, sandstorm haze, a giant basilisk shadow
the upper halls of Blackrock Mountain: orc war banners of the Black Dragonflight, chains, spiked iron, molten rock glow, black dragon eggs, a dragon silhouette
a vast Dark Iron dwarf city inside Blackrock Mountain: lava rivers, forges and anvils, giant dwarf statues, smoke, chains, an arena ring
the volcanic lair of the black dragon Onyxia in Dustwallow Marsh: scorched cave, dragon eggs, heaps of gold coins, smoke, glowing embers, the shadow of huge wings
a necromancy school in a crypt beneath Caer Darrow: candles, bookshelves with forbidden tomes, skulls, bone constructs, ghostly green glow, gothic arches
a jungle troll capital in Stranglethorn Vale: overgrown stone ziggurats, blood-red mist, tiger and bat idols, giant snakes, voodoo masks, lush jungle leaves
the burning, plague-ridden city of Stratholme: ruined Lordaeron houses, plague cauldrons with green fumes, fire and ash, undead silhouettes, broken Scarlet banners
a sacred centaur and elemental cavern in Desolace: giant crystals in purple and green, glowing waterfalls, twisted ancient roots, poison mist, a stone giant shadow
a volcanic cave beneath Orgrimmar: lava pools, red rock, burning braziers, troggs and cultist silhouettes, shadow council symbols, heat haze
the fiery heart of Blackrock Mountain: rivers of lava, molten giants, fire elementals, obsidian rock, the shadow of Ragnaros rising from flames
the overgrown ruins of the ancient elven city of Eldre'Thalas in Feralas: broken elven arches and columns, glowing arcane crystals, ogre silhouettes, vines and trees, satyr shadows
the black dragon lair atop Blackrock Mountain: dark stone halls, dragon eggs and incubators, chromatic dragon shadows, chains, lava glow, Nefarian's banners
ruined silithid temple outskirts in Silithus: sandy desert, giant insect hives, qiraji obelisks, scarabs, ancient yellow stone, a dusty violet sky
the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj in Silithus: titanic insectoid architecture, qiraji statues, glowing purple runes, chitin pillars, the eye of an old god in the shadows
the floating necropolis of the Scourge: frost-blue and sickly green light, spider webs, abominations, plague vats, bones, gothic necropolis spires
an ancient dwarven tomb hall: rows of stone thane statues and burial niches, a crystal-filled cavern with pale blue crystals, carved runes, torchlight on granite
the ruined capital city of Lordaeron: broken white marble throne room, collapsed towers, plague-green fog, dead trees, crows, torn royal banners
a dwarven archaeological dig in the misty Wetlands: excavation scaffolding and tents, crates and pickaxes, marshland, mossy ruins, rugged mountains in fog
the magical city of Dalaran: violet spires and domes, floating arcane runes, glowing purple magic, books and scrolls, and dark sewers below
a sunken troll city: drowned stone ziggurats under water, seaweed, coral, troll tiki carvings, naga silhouettes, shafts of light through deep water
a corrupted furbolg stronghold in a dark forest cave: wooden palisades, bear totems, fel-green corruption, twisted roots, glowing fungi
an island fortress prison in Dustwallow Marsh: massive stone walls, iron cell doors, chains, watchtowers, crashing waves and swamp fog, a dark storm
a titan shaper terrace in a primal jungle crater: ancient titan machinery and terraces, glowing green crystals, giant ferns, dinosaur silhouettes, steam vents
a brutal ogre stronghold: crude wooden spikes and huts, giant clubs, skulls, war drums, campfires, rocky canyon walls
